card.name: Mid-sentence words before a line break
card.fires_on: Ordinary words in running web text (prepositions, units, nouns, dashes) where the model seems to expect the line to end soon. No single word type or topic fits.

modes.label: Small linking words
modes.description: Prepositions, conjunctions and dashes in the middle of a sentence or list entry.
modes.example: Buran shuttle made an unmanned spaceflight<< in>> November 1988.

modes.label: Units and nouns
modes.description: A unit or noun that ends a short phrase, such as km or pressure.
modes.example: The top of the storm rises 8<< km>> above surrounding clouds.

modes.label: Dashes in lists
modes.description: A dash between dates or scenario labels in a list.

card.writes: It raises newline and whitespace tokens and lowers dollar-sign and odd symbol tokens.
card.plain: It fires on everyday words in web text and nudges the model toward starting a new line.
